name: strategy_ablation
review_mode: Independent complete source and actual evidence review of pr_audit's fixed implementation; Rust was not rerun by this reviewer.
review_scope: Six crate paths implement a development public-strategy benchmark and its focused controls. Exact source admission covers the runner/reporting/CLI and tests; documentation is separately present in the integration.
root_review: Root read the complete strategy runner, reporting, CLI diff, protocol controls, actual loopback test and documentation. Root reviewed canonical product/compiler-artifact and execution receipts, reproduced storage verification for all 303 retained originals, and kept the original and canonical lint failures separate. The implementation admits only explicit fixed source/build/binary input and actual observed equal request budgets, preserves all acquired response Values before protocol rejection, and states the public-policy and fake-profile limits.

validation.strict_clippy: Initial canonical command 101 retained; targeted cc-eval clean followed by unchanged command exit 0.

accepted_contract: local/auto/semantic public policies are compared over the same locked suite, binary, configuration, input population and semantic readiness target; complete effective deadlines/candidate/hard-scope/token/response budgets are checked.
The actual semantic public policy still includes local retrieval lanes; dense-only is explicitly unsupported instead of simulated by weights or hidden production flags.
Returned JSON Values and warm-up observations remain in raw records, and paired comparisons use per-question means followed by query-family grouping and fixed-seed bootstrap.
Originating retrieval work and final-assembly validation work retain separate scope. Missing provider billing and current-query cache attribution remain null/unknown.
The complete actual runner used an owned literal loopback constant-vector provider without gold access, and preserved all 27 acquired Values and 18 measured rows.
limits: The isolated delta has 768 inputs and was not behavior-run by itself; the author source had 772. Its six exact changed blobs are preserved without claiming whole-tree identity.

Default/HTTP builds and runners have explicit canonical receipts after targeted workspace cleanup. Prior shared-target observations and both original lint failures remain historical records; this is not hermetic build attestation.
All enabled cells, including local, wait for dense readiness. This is a query-policy comparison, not an indexing-cost comparison of semantic disabled versus enabled.
The retained JSON Values are not all wire bytes. RPC transport errors may have no returned Value and stay under the generic runner's error handling.

The original dense-only counterfactual and genuine corpus/provider quality leg remain open. Fake score differences and intervals do not certify semantic benefit; paid cost, scale, G7 and release are not approved.
A later combined source needs separately attributable validation. No original scorer, gold, retrieval weight, budget, test oracle or task dependency was weakened.
